title: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
abstract: arXiv:2610.01325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning for trading often struggles to balance upside participation with drawdown control. Profit-only policies can collapse toward passive long exposure on upward-drifting assets, while aggressively risk-penalized rewards can become too defensive during volatile periods. This paper proposes PPO-HRAP, a hybrid regime-aware policy that combines Proximal Policy Optimization with an interpretable regime prior. The agent observes both market features and portfolio-state variables, receives a reward combining portfolio log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown-increase penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost, and executes a blended action between the PPO actor output and a regime-derived target exposure. On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, PPO-HRAP achieves 27.62% total return, 8.48% annualized return, 0.6447 Sharpe ratio, 0.8588 Sortino ratio, and 0.4592 Calmar ratio, while reducing maximum drawdown from 34.10%

translated_title: PPO-HRAP：基于混合市场状态感知策略的近端策略优化风险控制交易方法
translated_abstract: 面向交易的强化学习常常难以在上涨行情参与度与回撤控制之间取得平衡：仅以利润为目标的策略在持续上行的资产上可能退化为被动的多头持仓，而过度惩罚风险的奖励函数在波动剧烈的时期又可能变得过于保守。本文提出了PPO-HRAP，这是一种混合市场状态感知策略，将近端策略优化（PPO）与可解释的市场状态先验相结合。智能体同时观察市场特征与投资组合状态变量，其奖励函数综合了投资组合对数收益率、基于VIX条件化的回撤增加惩罚、目标仓位偏差以及换手成本，并执行PPO策略网络输出与由市场状态推导出的目标仓位之间的混合动作。在2020-2022年SPY留出测试区间上，PPO-HRAP实现了27.62%的总收益、8.48%的年化收益、0.6447的夏普比率、0.8588的索提诺比率和0.4592的卡玛比率，同时将最大回撤从34.10%（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出PPO-HRAP，将近端策略优化（PPO）与可解释的市场状态先验相结合，通过PPO输出与状态推导目标仓位的混合动作执行以及包含VIX条件化回撤惩罚的风险感知奖励，在上涨参与度与回撤控制之间取得平衡，在2020-2022年SPY测试中实现27.62%总收益并显著降低最大回撤。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PPO-HRAP, a hybrid regime-aware policy that combines PPO with an interpretable regime prior, executing blended actions between the actor output and regime-derived target exposure under a VIX-conditioned risk-aware reward, balancing upside participation with drawdown control and achieving 27.62% total return with substantially reduced maximum drawdown on the 2020-2022 SPY test window.
